features.text: Soft cotton shoulder sling designed specifically for growing children's comfort and support needs
Easy-to-adjust shoulder strap helps parents maintain proper arm positioning for optimal healing
Fun patterns and colors make this medical support more appealing to young patients
Universal design fits both right and left arms, with gentle stabilizing support for injured shoulders

measurement: Finding the right size shoulder sling is crucial for your child's comfort and recovery. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page where our caring team will help ensure a perfect fit for your young one.
